event_contracts.signup: No successful-signup event surfaced in the returned event taxonomy; missing coverage does not prove zero signups.
event_contracts.oauth_completed: MCP OAuth completed; source=mcp. Not a signup or executor start.
event_contracts.task_template_executed: Client event after executeTaskTemplate returns successfully, not authoritative executor-start lifecycle.
event_contracts.workflow_run_started: Client event after API acceptance; backend MCP lifecycle capture also exists. Not automatically a successful executor result.

limitations: Dates are UTC calendar days, whereas Search Console daily dates are Pacific; domain/host scopes also differ.
Channel/landing-page unique visitors can overlap across categories; do not add row uniques to calculate overall uniques.
AI channel has five visitors with utm_source=chatgpt.com but direct/missing referring domain; not proof of independent endorsements or citations.

Organic funnel starts are apex pageviews classified Organic Search, followed in order by chosen proxy within7days; remaining steps are not globally host- or bot-filtered so server and app outcomes can match.
Zero observed proxy conversions is not zero real qualification: identity links, anonymous-to-account association, consent, sparse events, cross-device use and cohort maturity remain limits.
Schema outputs and source code confirm event meaning, but current deployed source parity is not fully verified.
No full person records, personal addresses, distinct IDs or session IDs are stored.
